objective: Restore Edit and Delete for own BUKLOD public/scoped Wall comments on Android by replacing the truncated native Comment alert with one scrollable, accessible action modal.
productionBaselineEvidence: The screenshot on Android Nov 13 2026 shows only Reply, Copy Text and React; repository main and staging have the same original comment bubble blob SHA 150570174445c657bc1ae60be43a30c05f8e8e1c. Read-only production BUKLOD Connect Supabase inspection confirms public/scoped delete RPCs and author/moderator checks. Exact production OTA/source fingerprint and physical staging-device behavior have not been verified.
chosenApproach: Replace Alert.alert with a single React Native Modal switching between action list, edit, reaction picker, delete confirmation, and details; add a header More button; compute owner actions from authenticated currentUserId, preserve scope can_manage; call existing onDelete RPC only after confirmation and show errors/retry.
selectionRationale: Android Alert.alert supports only three dialog action buttons, hiding Delete. One shared modal avoids nested-modal races, requires no new native dependency or backend change, and preserves original reply/reaction/media/report handlers.
alternativeApproaches: Reorder the Android alert to show Delete among the first three: rejected because it still hides Report/Edit and causes different behavior on iOS.
Add an unconditional visible Delete button to every comment: rejected because it clutters the conversation and risks misleading users without delete permission.
preserveBehaviors: Public and scoped Community Wall comments, replies, GIF/photos, text, mentions, reactions, reporting, profile links, and per-comment dates remain intact.
Existing backend author and scoped moderator/server-side policy remains authoritative; no direct database deletion or security permission widening.
Public post reaction counts/comment counts refresh via existing post load and exact-scope fetch; no media uploader/video/AdMob/Connect changes.
Current app runtime version and Expo production OTA channel untouched; change enters staging-first DEV branch only.
acceptanceChecks: On Android, long press and More both show all available actions, not just the first three.
Current author sees Edit/Delete; other viewers see neither, except moderators with scoped can_manage can delete.
Delete asks for confirmation, disables repeated taps during network work, and reports errors with a retry option.
Reply, Copy Text, React, Report, profile visit, and details stay functional; comments reload after server-confirmed deletion.
Staging PR must pass objective scope/engineering regression plus TypeScript and focused tests before any RC or production OTA.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Android native comment menu truncated owned comment actions and prevented users from discovering Delete, despite valid existing server RPCs.
preservedBehaviors: No change to post privacy, account isolation, comment/reaction RPCs, media/ads playback, GIF composer, or existing navigation.
